title: A robot with rich sensorimotor mastery would have experiences

statements.text: A robot that masters sensorimotor contingencies, is embodied so that its encounters have bodiliness and grabbiness, and uses that mastery to engage the world in a thoughtful and adaptable way would have at least primitive visual experiences. A simple ping-pong robot would not.

sources.quote: it becomes necessary to say that it has (at least primitive) visual experiences
